evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 433.8→442.7 °C, physically implausible versus all column temps (63-75 °C) and drifting monotonically ~0.45 °C/min with no process response
Reflux and distillate flows essentially zero throughout (occasional 0.1-2.0 L/h blips), FYI702 = 0, so no reflux/takeoff is established
Column temperatures flat/oscillating around 64-75 °C with no developing separation profile
Pressure drops steady (~0.7 / ~2.9 mbar) and PY23 stable at 500 mbar, indicating little vapour traffic

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/heater duty reading to confirm T701 sensor drift, and verification of reflux pump/valve status to explain zero FT703/FT704; a distillate composition sample would be needed for any scientific conclusion.
